acceptance_criteria.criterion: Projection: exact depth-one member span only, nested bytes preserved, permitted sites empty, caller masks malformed, all other payload/stderr/exit bytes compared.
acceptance_criteria.note: Depth-one JSON walk locates the provenance member; the removed span must be exactly line-leading spaces, the key token, ': ', the string token, a trailing comma and LF. Absent/invalid value -> provenance-expected; duplicates or any extra span content -> projection-unique. nested members and every byte outside the span remain compared; stderr and exits compared as raw buffers. normalizations.json must be []: any caller mask exits 2. Generic readiness-contract/2 refusals compare unchanged and classify as equal-refusal, never as success.
